name: Sudden Panic
body:
School necromancy [emotion, fear, mind-affecting]; Level antipaladin 4, bard 3, bloodrager 4, death mage 4, inquisitor 4, lathspell 3, legendary ninja 4, shaman 4, sorcerer/wizard 4, white necromancer 4, witch 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action
Components V

EFFECT

Range 30 ft.

Area cone-shaped burst
Duration 1 round
Saving Throw Will partial; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You create a cone of terror that makes those within panicked for 1 round if they fail their saving throw. On a success, they are shaken for 1 round.
